notes:
SMB inbound from sales enablement/call-summary app. Early-stage team (founder Tom Li). Wants hosted API that is self-serve — low friction. Primary concerns: PII handling (phone numbers, email addresses, customer names), retention windows, and ability to set short TTLs for transcripts. Typical workload: post-call transcript -> summary + CRM field extraction -> coach flags. Latency tolerance is moderate: 2-5s per summary acceptable for async flow; embedding generation for search should be background. Cost sensitivity high (early SMB budget). Model prefs: open models ok, but wants guidance on quantization and batching to keep cost down. Routing/fallback: will accept lower-cost variant for non-critical transcripts.

Shorthand notes from call:
- "We can't keep phone numbers in plain text; need auto-redact or hashing"
- "Retention needs: 7 days default, 90 days for flagged items"
- "PII requirement likely for customers in US/CA; want region-aware storage"
- "Self-serve onboarding critical; want to try hosted API before contract"

Action items: send SOC2 cert, short note about retention controls and redaction examples, pricing estimate for 5-20k tokens/mo, sample snippet showing redaction pipeline (client-side & server-side options). POC ask: 30 days, up to 10k tokens, one webhook + CRM sync demo. Potential upsell: Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and cost saving.
